title: Validate pod-to-hosted migration with a real candidate
description:
# Validate pod-to-hosted migration with a real candidate

## Intent

As a publication whose needs have outgrown a pod, I want its valuable story history and provenance to be reconstructable in hosted Papyrus, so that graduation does not require starting from raw prose.

## Entry criteria

- A real pod operator has a concrete hosted capability need and chooses to evaluate migration.
- The migration target and retained information are explicitly scoped.

## Definition of Done

- Stable story identity, assignments, stage outputs, source citations, editorial decisions, final copy, publication metadata, and media references are assessed against the hosted import path.
- One real story is migrated or reconstructed and the effort, loss, and manual decisions are measured.
- The outcome defines the supported migration promise without implying schema parity or a configuration switch.

## Non-goals

- Prebuilding migration infrastructure without a candidate.
- Seamless dual-backend operation.
- Keeping pod and hosted records continuously synchronized.
